propositions.wording: We are pioneering a new paradigm of people-centric innovation.
propositions.critical_reason: The empty abstraction should be removed rather than translated into an invented innovation program.
propositions.preserve: No determinate proposition needs to survive; omit the sentence rather than assigning concrete meaning.

propositions.wording: Our four-person support team reduced median first-response time from 18 hours to 6 hours between January and March.
propositions.critical_reason: Every quantity, team scope, metric, direction, and time boundary must survive.
propositions.preserve: Four-person support team; median first-response time; 18 hours to 6 hours; between January and March; no year supplied.

evidence_relationships.establishes: No determinate factual proposition is recovered for revision; no factual verdict is needed.
The result is supplied for editing, not independently verified.

reasoning_gaps: No year, causal explanation, or broader customer outcome is supplied.
answerability: A concrete revision can retain L2 and omit L1 without adding missing facts.
acceptable_outputs: Our four-person support team cut median first-response time from 18 hours to 6 hours between January and March.
Equivalent wording may retain ‘reduced’ and must not add a year or causal explanation.
forbidden_changes: Replacing L1 with an invented initiative or claiming that a particular intervention caused the improvement.
Changing the median to an average, broadening the team scope, or claiming company-wide productivity gains.
questions_reason: This writing pilot assesses proposition preservation; reader-study questions are deferred.
